slides.title: A long action title that runs close to one hundred characters to test two-line fitting at size

points.headline: First message is a full sentence that is nearly ninety characters long for testing
points.detail: Supporting detail sentence that explains the message in about one hundred and fifty characters, which is the recommended maximum.

points.headline: Second message is also a full sentence close to the recommended length limit
points.detail: Another detail line of similar length so that every row in the summary has two lines of headline and two lines of detail at most.

points.headline: Third message keeps the same length so the rows stay balanced on the page
points.detail: The builder should shrink all rows to one common size rather than letting some rows use bigger text than the others do.

points.headline: Fourth message checks that five rows still fit in the body area of the slide
points.detail: If the rows do not fit at twelve points the build report must flag an overflow instead of silently cutting text off.

points.headline: Fifth message closes the summary with the ask for the decision makers
points.detail: This last detail line is the same length as the others to keep the test honest about the worst case for this layout.

footnotes: Note: all text on this slide is placeholder copy written for the layout test.
